notes.title: Full release!!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! Orbital Cascade has officially left Early Access and is now fully released on Steam!

Thank you to everyone who supported the game during development, your feedback has been invaluable.

This last update includes:
✅ Achievements to challenge yourself and show off your skills
✅ Several bug fixes for a smoother experience
✅ Overall improvements for better gameplay


Join the community and share your high scores on Discord: Discord Server

See you in orbit! 🌌

notes.title: Big Update: New Level & Prepping to leave Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Exciting news, a brand new level, Squarantine, has just been added in the latest update!
It’s wild, it’s chaotic, and it’s probably going to confuse you (in the best way possible). Hope you’re ready for the challenge!

Introducing Squarantine – A Fusion of Chaos

[previewyoutube=Te2QQHSzHxo;full][/previewyoutube]


Squarantine is what happens when you take the mechanics of Hexogenesis and Hexanihilation, smash them together, and hope for the best. It’s a fusion of both previous levels.

In this level, you’ll need to rotate and move your plane, just like in Hexanihilation, but now with an added layer of complexity from Hexogenesis.
The challenge? Adapting to both movement styles at once, balancing precision with quick decision-making. Expect unexpected twists, and a lot of "what just happened?" moments.

Leaving Early Access Next Week!
That’s right, next week, the game will officially be leaving Early Access! 🎉

With the full release, you can expect:

More achievements to unlock (because who doesn’t love achievements?).
Bug fixes to smooth out any lingering rough edges.
A huge thank you to everyone who played, gave feedback, and supported the game. Your enthusiasm has been incredible, and I couldn’t have done this without you!
Go check out Squarantine, and get ready for the full launch next week! 🚀

notes.title: Smoother Controls, Better Saves & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🚀

A new Friday update is here! This update focuses on smoother input handling and fixing pesky bugs to make the game feel even better.

🎮 Improved Controls & UI Fixes
Pause & Unpause Fixes: The pause menu is now more responsive and won’t lurk in the shadows when not in use.
Controller Fixes: No more clashing inputs—controls should feel much smoother!
🎨 Visual & Gameplay Fixes
Ring Colors Fixed: Rings now always match their expected colors.
Bomb Display Fixed: No more weird visuals—bombs should now appear correctly.
Controller Rotation Feels Better: Rotation now works based on left and right input instead of absolute positioning, making movement more intuitive.
I’ve also cleaned up some stuff behind the scenes!

BTW... The level name is now displayed. Does it mean something? Who knows... Stay tuned to find out! 👀

That’s it for now—let me know if you run into any issues, and as always, thanks for playing! 😃
